brief: The LinkedIn content loop that built a 50K following in 6 months.

slots.author: Jordan Miles
slots.headline: The Content Loop Behind 50K Followers
slots.body: This exact system took me from zero to 50,000 followers in six months. Steal the framework below.

slots.author: Jordan Miles
slots.title: Start With a Bold Hook
slots.body: Your first line must stop the scroll. Use a strong opinion, a number, or a contrarian take to pull readers in.

slots.author: Jordan Miles
slots.title: Share a Personal Story
slots.body: People connect with people, not faceless brands. Tell a quick story that shows the struggle before the solution.

slots.author: Jordan Miles
slots.title: Drop the Actionable Framework
slots.body: Give away the step-by-step process. Make it so practical that readers feel compelled to save the post for later.

slots.author: Jordan Miles
slots.title: Design Simple Carousels
slots.body: Break complex ideas into swipeable slides. Visual repetition trains the algorithm and keeps your audience coming back daily.

slots.author: Jordan Miles
slots.title: Ask for Engagement
slots.body: End every post with a question. Comments signal relevance to LinkedIn, which pushes your content to a wider network.

slots.author: Jordan Miles
slots.title: Repeat for 180 Days
slots.body: Consistency compounds. Publish this loop daily for six months, and watch your following grow from strangers to true fans.
